# hub.meshsat.net is the application, not a marketing surface. Getting an
# account is an approval, not a self-service signup, so there is nothing here
# for a search engine to index: every route behind "/" needs a session, and the
# app is hash-routed, so a crawler following links finds one page.
#
# This file exists because the Hub used to answer /robots.txt with the SPA
# shell. Google treats an unparseable robots.txt as "no rules" and crawled the
# whole app, and meshsat.net is a DNS-verified DOMAIN property, so the Hub's
# soft 404s counted against it (MESHSAT-1185). auth.meshsat.net says the same
# thing for the same reason.
#
# Disallowing crawling is not hiding: the Hub is open with owner approval
# (MESHSAT-995). It keeps an application out of a search index.
User-agent: *
Disallow: /
